notes.title: "Sayonara Okaasan" – Out Now!
notes.notes:
This piece invites you on a journey through parting and the delicate boundary between life and death. 
I hope it encourages each player to reflect on their own emotions and discover meaning in its poetic world.

It is a work crafted with care, and I’m truly delighted to share it with you!

notes.title: Sayonara Okaasan - 1 Day Left!
notes.notes:
A journey through the final moments of life, Sayonara Okaasan is a poetic interactive experience now on the verge of release.

We’re truly excited to share this special world with all of you!

See you soon in Sayonara Okaasan!

notes.title: Release Date Announced!
notes.notes:
[b]December 11th, 2024 (PT)[/b]

The release date has been set!
A unique interactive piece combining poetry, puzzles, and art will soon be available.

Don't forget to add it to your wishlist!

notes.title: Sayonara Okaasan: Coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The Sayonara Okaasan Steam page is now live! I began creating this game from my personal experience, and it’s been an incredible journey. I’m so excited to share this project with you all soon!

Feel free to add it to your wishlist to stay updated, and thank you for your interest and support!
